nodes.label: H1b Cao 2019 Trajectories Figure (sustained driving, mean +- SE)

nodes.rationale: 7-panel line chart of change vs minutes 0-5 across ~120 min of sustained driving, mean +- SE across subjects. Behavior: log10 RT and uncorrected-drift lapse fraction rise sharply in first ~20 min (RT ~+0.25 log s, lapses ~+0.14) then decay toward baseline. Periodic Fz/FCz theta rises gradually (~0 to ~0.6 dB). Tonic (total power) theta peaks early (~+1.2 dB at ~20 min) then declines below baseline. Periodic and total posterior alpha rise ~+1.5-2 dB and stay elevated until ~105 min. Posterior aperiodic exponent slightly up early, then drifts down. Final points (>105 min) show large drops/spikes with very wide SE, likely few subjects remaining (unreliable).
